messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Definition of QTL
parts:
Sorry for the confusion. 

Scanone function can give the LOD score across the genetic map. We can pick peak and then se can use lodint or bayesint to estimate the peak ends. With peak ends, the QTL is defined. The QTL may contain many markers (variants with known genotype). Next, we need to estimate how much phenotypic variance the QTL can explain. Should we use all markers inside the QTL as input of the makeqtl function and then run fitqtl to get the result?


Thanks!
